topic: Decision Making to Improve Human Resource Performance
subject: business-studies

moments.title: Illumination studies begin
moments.body: Western Electric's lighting studies produce confusing results: productivity rises whether illumination goes up or down.
moments.takeaway: Confounds in field studies can yield more interesting findings than intended.

moments.title: Relay assembly studies conclude
moments.body: Long-term observation of a small assembly group identifies social factors and supervisory style as productivity drivers.
moments.takeaway: Workers respond to attention, not just incentives.

moments.title: The Social Problems of an Industrial Civilization
moments.body: Mayo's book frames the human relations school's response to scientific management.
moments.takeaway: Management theory branches into social-psychological terrain.

now.title: Human relations today
now.body: Engagement, culture and psychological safety draw on the human relations lineage; algorithmic management partly reverses the trend.
now.open_questions: Can human relations principles be implemented through software?

reflection: Hawthorne is taught everywhere; its data is messier than the textbook story.
